description: Outcome-review STEERING card (user 2026-09-24: '아웃컴 리뷰에 조향카드 부여하는 것 동의'). Written by outcome_review.py when a verdict REPEATS (a slug in this review and the previous one). The runner carries it in cycle/1 `steer`; the judgement session answers it in next/1 `steer` (follow, or refuse with evidence). Two refusals of the same `item` stop the runner and add a decisions_pending item. From 2026-10-09 (card chat-D2, user '둘 다 넣자') the runner also writes one from a Claude-GPT DISCUSSION (outcome every 5 cycles, or a stuck cycle): item `debate:<slug>`, verdict `debate-outcome` / `debate-stuck`, required_act = the items both speakers agreed (protocol.steer_from_debate).
